name: Kulasuriya I.M.G.H.N
queries: SELECT UserID, NIC, EmergencyContact FROM dbo.Patient ORDER BY UserID;

SELECT p.UserID, CONCAT(u.FirstName,' ',u.LastName) AS PatientName, c.ContactNumber FROM dbo.Patient p JOIN dbo.Users u ON u.UserID=p.UserID LEFT JOIN dbo.PatientContact c ON c.PatientID=p.UserID ORDER BY p.UserID,c.ContactNumber;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS PatientCount FROM dbo.Patient;
Patients with more than one contact
SELECT PatientID, COUNT(*) AS ContactCount FROM dbo.PatientContact GROUP BY PatientID HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY PatientID;
SELECT UserID,NIC FROM dbo.Patient p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Appointment a WHERE a.PatientID=p.UserID AND a.Status='SCHEDULED') ORDER BY UserID;
valid:
UPDATE dbo.Patient SET EmergencyContact='0700000199' WHERE UserID IN (1,2);
SELECT UserID,EmergencyContact FROM dbo.Patient WHERE UserID IN (1,2);
invalid: UPDATE dbo.Patient SET NIC=CASE UserID WHEN 1 THEN '200000000099' ELSE NIC END WHERE UserID IN (1,2);
rule: New viva business rule: keep patient NIC stable after a completed visit; emergency contacts remain editable.

name: Salinda L.L.S.U
queries: SELECT UserID,Specialization,ConsultationFee FROM dbo.Doctor WHERE ConsultationFee<=2000 ORDER BY ConsultationFee,UserID;

SELECT d.UserID,CONCAT(u.FirstName,' ',u.LastName) AS DoctorName,b.BranchName FROM dbo.Doctor d JOIN dbo.Users u ON u.UserID=d.UserID JOIN dbo.DoctorBranch db ON db.DoctorID=d.UserID JOIN dbo.HospitalBranch b ON b.BranchID=db.BranchID ORDER BY d.UserID,b.BranchID;
SELECT MIN(ConsultationFee) AS LowestFee,MAX(ConsultationFee) AS HighestFee,CAST(AVG(ConsultationFee) AS decimal(10,2)) AS AverageFee FROM dbo.Doctor;
SELECT DoctorID,COUNT(*) AS BranchCount FROM dbo.DoctorBranch GROUP BY DoctorID HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY DoctorID;
SELECT UserID,Specialization,ConsultationFee FROM dbo.Doctor WHERE ConsultationFee>(SELECT AVG(ConsultationFee) FROM dbo.Doctor) ORDER BY UserID;
valid:
UPDATE dbo.Doctor SET ConsultationFee=ConsultationFee+100 WHERE UserID IN (6,7);
SELECT UserID,ConsultationFee FROM dbo.Doctor WHERE UserID IN (6,7);
invalid: UPDATE dbo.Doctor SET LicenseNo=CASE UserID WHEN 6 THEN 'SLMC-VIVA-099' ELSE LicenseNo END WHERE UserID IN (6,7);
rule: New viva business rule: preserve the doctor license identifier after a completed visit; fees remain editable.

name: Pannila P.L.K.S
queries: SELECT BranchID,BranchName,Location FROM dbo.HospitalBranch ORDER BY BranchID;

SELECT b.BranchName,d.UserID AS DoctorID,d.Specialization FROM dbo.HospitalBranch b JOIN dbo.DoctorBranch db ON db.BranchID=b.BranchID JOIN dbo.Doctor d ON d.UserID=db.DoctorID ORDER BY b.BranchID,d.UserID;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS BranchCount FROM dbo.HospitalBranch;
Branches with at least two doctors
SELECT BranchID,COUNT(*) AS DoctorCount FROM dbo.DoctorBranch GROUP BY BranchID HAVING COUNT(*)>=2 ORDER BY BranchID;
SELECT BranchID,BranchName FROM dbo.HospitalBranch b WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Appointment a WHERE a.BranchID=b.BranchID AND a.Status='SCHEDULED') ORDER BY BranchID;
valid:
UPDATE dbo.HospitalBranch SET BranchName=BranchName+N' (viva)' WHERE BranchID IN (1,2);
SELECT BranchID,BranchName FROM dbo.HospitalBranch WHERE BranchID IN (1,2);
invalid: UPDATE dbo.HospitalBranch SET Location=CASE BranchID WHEN 1 THEN N'New town' ELSE Location END WHERE BranchID IN (1,2);
rule: New viva business rule: changing branch location requires resolving its scheduled visits first; branch names remain editable.

name: Dhanukshan S.
queries: SELECT AppointmentID,PatientID,DoctorID,AppointmentAt FROM dbo.Appointment WHERE Status='SCHEDULED' ORDER BY AppointmentAt,AppointmentID;

SELECT a.AppointmentID,CONCAT(p.FirstName,' ',p.LastName) AS PatientName,CONCAT(d.FirstName,' ',d.LastName) AS DoctorName,b.BranchName,a.AppointmentAt,a.Status FROM dbo.Appointment a JOIN dbo.Users p ON p.UserID=a.PatientID JOIN dbo.Users d ON d.UserID=a.DoctorID JOIN dbo.HospitalBranch b ON b.BranchID=a.BranchID ORDER BY a.AppointmentID;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalAppointments,SUM(CASE WHEN Status='COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CompletedAppointments FROM dbo.Appointment;
SELECT DoctorID,COUNT(*) AS VisitCount FROM dbo.Appointment WHERE Status<>'CANCELLED' GROUP BY DoctorID HAVING COUNT(*)>=2 ORDER BY VisitCount DESC,DoctorID;
SELECT AppointmentID,PatientID,AppointmentAt FROM dbo.Appointment a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Invoice i WHERE i.AppointmentID=a.AppointmentID AND i.Status='UNPAID') ORDER BY AppointmentID;
valid:
UPDATE dbo.Appointment SET Status='CANCELLED' WHERE AppointmentID IN (6,7);
SELECT AppointmentID,Status FROM dbo.Appointment WHERE AppointmentID IN (6,7);
invalid: UPDATE dbo.Appointment SET Status='CANCELLED' WHERE AppointmentID IN (1,6);
rule: New viva business rule: COMPLETED is a terminal appointment state. This also protects existing completed-visit feedback.

name: Ariyawansha N.S.K
queries: SELECT NotificationID,UserID,Title,Status,SentAt FROM dbo.Notification WHERE Status='SENT' ORDER BY NotificationID;

SELECT n.NotificationID,CONCAT(u.FirstName,' ',u.LastName) AS Recipient,n.Title,a.AppointmentAt,n.Status FROM dbo.Notification n JOIN dbo.Users u ON u.UserID=n.UserID JOIN dbo.Appointment a ON a.AppointmentID=n.AppointmentID ORDER BY n.NotificationID;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalNotifications,SUM(CASE WHEN ReadAt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UnreadCount FROM dbo.Notification;
Delivery status groups with at least two records
SELECT Status,COUNT(*) AS NotificationCount FROM dbo.Notification GROUP BY Status HAVING COUNT(*)>=2 ORDER BY Status;
SELECT UserID,FirstName,LastName FROM dbo.Users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Notification n WHERE n.UserID=u.UserID AND n.Status='SENT' AND n.ReadAt IS NULL) ORDER BY UserID;
valid:
UPDATE dbo.Notification SET ReadAt=DATEADD(minute,1,SentAt) WHERE NotificationID IN (1,2);
SELECT NotificationID,SentAt,ReadAt FROM dbo.Notification WHERE NotificationID IN (1,2);
invalid: UPDATE dbo.Notification SET UserID=CASE NotificationID WHEN 1 THEN 2 ELSE UserID END WHERE NotificationID IN (1,2);
rule: New viva business rule: appointment notifications go to that appointment patient or doctor. SQL sample SENT values are fixtures, not real email delivery.

name: Metaramba M.K.K.N
queries: SELECT FeedbackID,AppointmentID,PatientID,Rating,Review FROM dbo.Feedback WHERE Rating>=4 ORDER BY FeedbackID;

SELECT f.FeedbackID,CONCAT(p.FirstName,' ',p.LastName) AS PatientName,CONCAT(d.FirstName,' ',d.LastName) AS DoctorName,f.Rating,f.Review FROM dbo.Feedback f JOIN dbo.Appointment a ON a.AppointmentID=f.AppointmentID JOIN dbo.Users p ON p.UserID=f.PatientID JOIN dbo.Users d ON d.UserID=a.DoctorID ORDER BY f.FeedbackID;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS PaidInvoiceCount,SUM(Amount) AS TotalPaidAmount,CAST(AVG(Amount) AS decimal(10,2)) AS AveragePaidAmount FROM dbo.Invoice WHERE Status='PAID';
Doctors with an average rating of at least four

SELECT a.DoctorID,CAST(AVG(CAST(f.Rating AS decimal(4,2))) AS decimal(4,2)) AS AverageRating,COUNT(*) AS ReviewCount FROM dbo.Feedback f JOIN dbo.Appointment a ON a.AppointmentID=f.AppointmentID GROUP BY a.DoctorID HAVING AVG(CAST(f.Rating AS decimal(4,2)))>=4 ORDER BY a.DoctorID;

SELECT p.UserID,p.NIC FROM dbo.Patient p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Appointment a JOIN dbo.Invoice i ON i.AppointmentID=a.AppointmentID WHERE a.PatientID=p.UserID AND i.Status='UNPAID') ORDER BY p.UserID;
trigger:
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER dbo.trg_Feedback_CompletedVisit
ON dbo.Feedback
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM inserted AS i
    JOIN dbo.Appointment AS a
      ON a.AppointmentID = i.AppointmentID
    WHERE a.Status <> 'COMPLETED'
  )
  BEGIN
    ;THROW 50001,
      'Feedback requires a completed appointment.', 1;
  END;
END;
GO
valid:
UPDATE dbo.Feedback SET Review=Review+N' (viva)' WHERE FeedbackID IN (1,2);
SELECT FeedbackID,AppointmentID,Rating,Review FROM dbo.Feedback WHERE FeedbackID IN (1,2);
invalid: UPDATE dbo.Feedback SET AppointmentID=6,PatientID=2 WHERE FeedbackID=1;
rule: Existing rule: feedback is allowed only for completed visits; composite FK also requires the correct patient.
